scope: Read-only independent review and eight temporary fake-host unit tests. No actual init.sh invocation, PM2 operation, datadir opening, archive/rename, key contents or live signatures.

findings_resolved.issue: Pre-created empty relay-N lacks the normal Go CLI RELAY_CLI marker.
findings_resolved.resolution: Only runtime parent is created; relay-N root and ownership marker are created by ordinary relay CLI.

findings_resolved.issue: An existing same-domain or unknown runtime could lose vote or signed-nonce safety history through archive/fresh restart.
findings_resolved.resolution: Any nonempty candidate DEX/relay history is rejected before process stops, irrespective of archive-journal existence.

findings_resolved.issue: Repeated wrapper reads overwrote the expected hash and could hide a stop-time configuration edit.
findings_resolved.resolution: read_bound rejects any changed digest already bound; fake stop-time wrapper edit produces no archive/init.

findings_resolved.issue: An initially empty runtime could receive a vote during shutdown before archive.
findings_resolved.resolution: All targets are revalidated after writer shutdown before any first archive, and each target is revalidated immediately before rename. Fake late vote preserves original CLX/DEX paths and initializes nothing.

checks: Exact named fourteen CLX apps plus only registered two relay apps; no sidecar separately managed by PM2.
Symlink/non-regular/hardlink wallet/nodekey rejection and 1MiB metadata size limits before first stop.
Whole-directory private same-filesystem archive; no rm/delete; wallets/nodekey selectively copied only into new CLX datadirs.
boot ID/PID/start-ticks descendants plus /proc file-descriptor/mmap/datadir writer absence required; permission denial refuses proceeding.
Only ordinary CLX CLI init is invoked; DEX/relay runtime never passed to CLX init. No role activation or process restart.
Interrupted or already-used generation journal blocks automatic repeat/rollback; retained original data enables separately reviewed recovery.
Same chain ID intentionally preserved; ordinary CLX transaction replay is not separated.
limits: This is readiness review, not PASS(LIVE) of actual initialization or restart. Parent will run read-only --check separately.
Nonempty DEX/relay histories are deliberately not reset by this first-generation helper. Recover same DB or prepare a separately reviewed new domain; do not remove the blocking files.
Failed initialization does not have automatic continuation: all named writers remain stopped and the private journal/archive must be inspected before any further action.
